notes.title: Welcome!
notes.content:
[b]Look what we've got for you.
[/b]
[list]
[*] File conversion is twice as high as before (accelerated conversion is still at the speed of light)
[*] Crop and Rotate buttons: you can find them on the same tab now

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1418790/ss_a0c0f7ee4b2b4a24e2a00ed7af47f06e60badcc6.1920x1080.jpg?t=1638449997[/img]

[*] Compressing button is finally here: now you can change your file size faster. Better late than never!
[*] The upgraded interface: explore its true beauty
[/list]

notes.title: Great news!
notes.content:
Here is a list of the new features:
[list]
[*] Crop videos with pinpoint accuracy
[*] Preview clips so you can delete unwanted segments with ease
[*] Undo and Redo tool will help you apply and cancel changes
[*] Scale up the timeline so you can cut your video more precisely
[/list]
You can convert movies, too. The SuperSpeed mode changes file formats in the blink of an eye and even saves at HD quality.
